# Price Oscillator

*Percentage difference between a short and a long moving average.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Price Oscillator** under **Oscillators**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Short length | int | `10` |
| Long length | int | `21` |
| Source | source | `"close"` |
| Exponential | bool | `false` |
| Color | color | `"#089981"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/ppo.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Price Oscillator", shortTitle: "PPO", overlay: false, precision: 2 });
const shortLength = input.int("Short length", 10, { min: 1 }), longLength = input.int("Long length", 21, { min: 1 });
const src = input.source("Source", "close");
const exponential = input.bool("Exponential", false);
const fast = exponential ? ta.ema(src, shortLength) : ta.sma(src, shortLength), slow = exponential ? ta.ema(src, longLength) : ta.sma(src, longLength);
plot(ta.calc([fast, slow], (f, s) => ((f - s) / s) * 100), { title: "PPO", color: input.color("Color", "#089981", { group: "Style" }) });
hline(0, { title: "Zero", color: "rgba(120,123,134,0.5)", style: "dashed" });
```
